Spain: 19 autonomous communities and cities, 50 provinces, 8130 municipalities with a 2025 Total in INE table 29005. Ceuta and Melilla are the city pages. 6 codes with an empty 2025 Total have no page.

Australia (https://mapthegeneral.com/au/): The Australian Electoral Commission says the next federal election is due between August 2027 and May 2028. No polling day was named in the sources read on 17 October 2026. This release has the national page, eight state and territory pages, 150 House of Representatives divisions, and Victoria’s 88 Legislative Assembly districts and 8 Legislative Council regions, in English. The Victorian Electoral Commission prints a state election on Saturday 28 November 2026.

Canada (https://mapthegeneral.com/ca/): Federal general election fixed for Monday, 15 October 2029, unless Parliament is dissolved earlier. The last general election was 28 April 2025. This release has the national page, 13 provinces and territories, 343 federal electoral districts, and 293 census divisions, in English and French.

Switzerland (https://mapthegeneral.com/ch/): National Council election on 24 October 2027, from the Federal Council release of 27 August 2025. This release has the national pages, the 26 cantons, and 135 district names from the FSO historized commune register, in German, French, Italian, and English. Municipality pages are not in this release.

Germany (https://mapthegeneral.com/de/): The Federal Returning Officer’s page for the election of the 22nd German Bundestag does not set a polling day. It places that day between 26 January 2029 and 25 March 2029. This release has the national page, the 16 Länder, 401 Kreise from the Destatis Gemeindeverzeichnis of 30 September 2026, and the 299 Bundestag constituencies, in German and English. Municipality pages are not in this release.

France (https://mapthegeneral.com/fr/): Presidential election on Sunday, 18 April 2027, with a runoff on Sunday, 2 May 2027, as published by Service-Public. This release has the national page, 18 regions, 101 departments and 577 legislative constituencies, in French and English. Commune pages are not in this release.

United Kingdom (https://mapthegeneral.com/gb/): UK Parliament general election, no later than 15 August 2029, in the Electoral Commission schedule. This release has the national page, England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, the 650 Westminster constituencies, Scottish Parliament constituencies and regions, Senedd constituencies and Northern Ireland Assembly constituencies, in English. Council, ward and candidate pages are not in this release.

Italy (https://mapthegeneral.com/it/): Camera dei deputati and Senato della Repubblica. The chambers were elected on Sunday, 25 September 2022 (decreto del Presidente della Repubblica 21 luglio 2022, n. 97). No later calling decree for the next general election was read, so this release does not print that polling day. National page, 20 regions, 110 ISTAT supra-municipal units, and the constituencies in legislative decree 177/2020, in Italian and English. Municipality pages are not in this release.

Japan (https://mapthegeneral.com/jp/): 289 House single-member districts, 11 proportional blocks, 45 House of Councillors districts, and 47 prefectures, in Japanese and English. Member lists read on 18 October 2026. No polling day for the next national election was proclaimed in the sources read.

South Korea (https://mapthegeneral.com/kr/): National Assembly election on 12 April 2028, from the 22nd term printed by the National Assembly minutes index and article 34 of the Public Official Election Act. This release has the national pages and 16 upper-level local governments, in Korean and English.

Mexico (https://mapthegeneral.com/mx/): Federal midterm on Sunday, 6 June 2027: 500 seats in the Cámara de Diputados, and local elections in the 32 entidades federativas, including 17 gubernaturas on the INE page. This release has the national page, the 32 entidades, the 300 federal single-member districts with the sitting deputy and the cabecera, and the five plurinominal constituencies, in Spanish and English. Municipality pages are not in this release.

Poland (https://mapthegeneral.com/pl/): Sejm and Senate: the constitutional window is 14 October to 12 November 2027, and the President sets the day. A Senate by-election in constituency 20 is ordered for 22 November 2026. This release has the national page, 16 voivodeships, 380 powiats, 41 Sejm constituencies and 100 Senate constituencies, in Polish and English. Gmina pages are not in this release.

Turkey (https://mapthegeneral.com/tr/): Presidential and parliamentary elections are held on the same day every five years. The last joint election was 14 May 2023. The next ordinary election falls in 2028; the polling day is not printed. This release has the national page, 81 provinces, 973 districts, and 87 parliamentary constituencies, in Turkish and English.
